description: NaH₄O₂Cl crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of one NaH₄O₂Cl sheet oriented in the (np.int64(1), np.int64(0), np.int64(0)) direction. Na is bonded to four O and two equivalent Cl atoms to form edge-sharing NaCl₂O₄ octahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.42 Å. Both Na-Cl bond lengths are 2.79 Å. There are four inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.97 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the fourth H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two H atoms. Cl is bonded in a distorted L-shaped geometry to two equivalent Na atoms.
